p.seg: Fán dú wǒ shī zhě, All who read my poems,
xīn zhōng xū hù jìng. must guard purity within their hearts.
Qiāntān jì rì lián, Be stingy and greedy no longer than a day, then be honest;
chǎnqū dēngshí zhèng. be flattering and crooked for no longer than an instant, then be upright.
Qūqiǎn chú è yè, Drive away and eliminate evil karma,
guīyī shòu zhēn xìng. take refuge and receive true nature.
Jīnrì dé fó shēn, Today attain the body of a Buddha,
jíjí rú lǜ lìng. quickly, quickly, as decreed by law!
Chóng yán wǒ bǔ jū. In layered cliffs, I chose my dwelling.
Niǎo dào jué rén jì. The bird path cuts off traces of people.
Tíng jì hé suǒ yǒu? What is there at the courtyard's edge?
Bái yún bào yōu shí. White clouds embrace secluded stones.
Zhù zī fán jǐ nián? How many years have I dwelt here?
Lǚ jiàn chūndōng yì. Repeatedly I've seen spring and winter change.
Jì yǔ zhōng dǐng jiā, Send word to families of bells and tripods,
xū míng dìng wú yì. empty fame is certainly of no benefit.
Kěxiào Hánshān dào, Laughable is the path of Hánshān,
ér wú chē mǎ zōng. and there are no traces of carts and horses.
It's hard to remember the bends of the linked streams.
One doesn't know the weight of the layered peaks.
A myriad kinds of grasses weep with dew.
The pines all hum in the wind.
At this moment, lost in the path,
the body asks the shadow, "Where do I go?"
My family likes to live in seclusion.
Our dwelling is far from the noise and dust.
Treading on the grass creates three paths.
Gazing at the clouds, we make them our four neighbors.
Birds assist with their songs.
But there is no one to ask about the Dharma.
Today's *Suō Pó* tree,
how many years until it sees one spring?
A zither and books must accompany me.
What use are rank and salary?
Throwing down the carriage, I follow a virtuous woman (wife).
The scarf-covered carriage has a filial son.
The wind blows, drying the wheat on the ground.
The overflowing water saturates the fishpond.
I often think of the wren:
it secures its body on a single branch.
Brothers shared five commanderies.
Father and son originated from three provinces.
To verify the gathering of flying ducks,
One must seek the roaming of white rabbits.
Miraculous melons received in dreams.
Divine oranges gathered in the seat.
How distant are the homeland and country!
Like a fish, sending messages with the flowing water.
Once, I was a scholar-swordsman.
Three times, I encountered wise and enlightened rulers.
In the east, guarding culture was not appreciated.
In the west, campaigning in war brought no merit.
Studying literature and also studying martial arts.
Studying martial arts and also studying literature.
Today, I am already old.
The rest of my life is not worth mentioning.
Zhuāngzǐ spoke of funerals,
Taking heaven and earth as the coffin.
The time for my return is at hand.
I only need a single coffin.
After death, my corpse will feed the green flies.
No need for white cranes to offer condolences.
I'll starve in Shǒuyáng Shān,
Living with integrity, dying is also joyous.
People ask about the way to Hánshān,
The road to Hánshān is impassable.
In summer, the ice has not yet melted,
At sunrise, the mist is hazy.
How can one like me arrive there?
My heart is not the same as yours.
If your heart were like mine,
You could still reach that place.
Heaven creates hundred-foot trees,
Which are cut into long strips of wood.
Luóhàn mén qián qǐ. They beg in front of the Arhats.
Chèn què xián héshang. Taking advantage of idle monks.
Bù wù wúwéi rén. Not understanding the person of non-action,
cónglái wú xiàngzhuàng. who has always been without form.
Fēng shū qǐng míng sēng. Seal the letter and invite famous monks.
(Unclear character) qián liǎng sān yàng. Giving money of two or three kinds.
Yúnguāng Hǎo Fǎshī. Venerable Yúnguāng Hǎo Fǎshī.
Ān jiǎo zài tóu shàng. Attaching horns to his head.
Rǔ wú píngděng xīn. You have no impartiality in your heart.
Shèngxián jù bù jiàng. Sages and worthies will not descend.
Fánshèng jiē hùnrán. The mundane and the sacred are all mixed together.
Quàn jūn xiū qǔ xiàng. I advise you to stop clinging to appearances.
Wǒ fǎ miào nán sī. My Dharma is wondrous and difficult to comprehend.
Tiānlóng jìn huíxiàng. Gods and Dragons all dedicate (merit).
Wǒ jīn qǐshǒu lǐ. Now I bow in reverence.
Wúshàng fǎ zhōng wáng. To the King of the Supreme Dharma.
Cíbēi dà xǐ shě. With compassion, great joy, and equanimity.
Míngchēng mǎn shí fāng. Whose name fills the ten directions.
Zhòngshēng zuò yī hù. Becomes the refuge for all beings.
Zhìhuì shēn jīngāng. Wisdom body of diamond.
Dǐnglǐ wú suǒ zhù. Bowing to the one who is unattached.
Wǒ shī dà fǎwáng. My teacher, the Great Dharma King.
Kěguì tiānrán wù. Precious, natural substance.
Dú yī wú bànlǚ. Alone, without a companion.
Mì tā bù kě jiàn. Seeking him, he cannot be seen.
Chūrù wú ménhù. Entering and exiting without a gate.
Cù zhī zài fāngcùn. Contracted, it is within an inch.
Yán zhī yīqiè chù. Extended, it is everywhere.
Nǐ ruò bù xìn ài. If you do not believe and love it.
Xiāngféng bù xiāngyù. You will meet, but not encounter it.
Walking through mud, my feet frequently stumble;
Sitting in the community, my stomach often aches.
Having lost my speckled cat,
Mice surround the rice urn.
I see the people of the world,
With their dignified and handsome appearances.
Bù bào fùmǔ ēn. They do not repay the kindness of their parents.
Fāngcùn dǐ múyàng. What is the state of their hearts?
Qiàn fù tārén qián. Owe others money,
tí chuān shǐ chóuchàng. only to feel remorse when the hooves are worn through (when it's too late).
Gègè xī qī ér. Each and every one cherishes their wives and children,
yé niáng bù gōngyǎng. but do not provide for their parents.
Xiōngdì sì yuānjia. Brothers are like enemies.
Xīnzhōng cháng chàngyàng. Their hearts are constantly filled with disappointment.
Yì xī shàonián shí. Recalling the days of youth,
qiú shén yuàn chéngzhǎng. praying to the gods for growth.
Jīn wèi bù xiàozǐ. Now they become unfilial sons.
Shìjiān duō cǐ yàng. The world is full of such people.
Mǎi ròu zìjiā (unclear character). Buy meat for their own families...
mǒ zuǐ dào wǒ chàng. Wipe their mouths and say, "I am satisfied."
Zì chěng shuō lóuluó. They boast and talk nonsense,
cōngmíng wúyì dāng. using their intelligence in useless ways.
Niútóu nǔ mù chēn. The ox-head glares angrily.
Chūqù shǐ shí xiàng. Only when leaving does the moment begin to make sense.
Zé fó shāo hǎo xiāng. They choose a Buddha and burn good incense.
jiǎn sēng guī gōngyǎng. They select a monk and return to make offerings.
Gēn zāo línggǔ biàn. Its roots have suffered changes in the hills and valleys.
Yè bèi fēngshuāng gǎi. Its leaves have been altered by wind and frost.
Xián xiào wài diāolíng. Everyone laughs at its outward withering.
Bù lián nèi wéncǎi. They don't appreciate its inner beauty.
Pífū tuōluò jìn. Its skin has completely peeled off.
Wéi yǒu zhēnshí zài. Only truthfulness remains.
Hánshān has a naked insect,
Its body white and its head black.
Holding two volumes of books in hand,
It uses one principle to lead one virtue.
Dwelling, it finds no comfort in the cooking stove,
Traveling, it doesn't care for tattered clothes.
It constantly wields the sword of wisdom,
Intending to vanquish the thieves of煩惱 (fánnǎo, affliction).
Some people fear white hair,
Unwilling to give up their red cords of office.
Vainly seeking immortality by gathering herbs,
They indiscriminately uproot roots and shoots.
After several years with no effect,
Their foolish intentions turn to anger and vexation.
The hunter wears a kasaya,
But it was never meant for you to use.
In the past, I was very poor;
Today, I am the poorest and freezing.
My actions are not harmonious,
Every path I take leads to futility.
Human life is one hundred years.
The Buddha speaks of twelve divisions.
Compassion is like a wild deer.
Anger and resentment are like a domestic dog.
A domestic dog cannot be chased away.
A wild deer is always prone to run away.
Yù fú míhóu xīn. If you wish to subdue the mind of a macaque (monkey).
Xū tīng shīzi hǒu. You must listen to the roar of a lion.
Jiào rǔ shù bān shì. I teach you several kinds of matters.
Sīliang zhī wǒ xián. If you ponder them, you'll know I'm wise.
Jí pín rěn mài wū. When extremely poor, bear to sell the house.
Cái fù xū mǎi tián. When newly wealthy, you must buy fields.
Kōng fù bùdé zǒu. One must not travel on an empty stomach.
Zhěntou xū mò mián. One must not sleep on a pillow (if one has things to do).
Cǐ yán qī zhòng jiàn. These words, I hope everyone sees them.
Guà zài rì dōng biān. Hang them on the eastern side of the sun (make them universally known).
Hánshān duō yōu qí. Hánshān (Cold Mountain) has much that is secluded and wondrous.
Dēng zhě jiē héng shè. Those who climb it are always awed.
Yuè zhào shuǐ chéng chéng. The moon illuminates the clear water.
Fēng chuī cǎo liè liè. The wind blows, rustling the grass.
Diāo méi xuě zuò huā. The withered plum blossoms, snow acts as their flowers.
Wù mù yún chōng yè. The gnarled tree, clouds fill in for its leaves.
Chù yǔ zhuǎn xiān líng. Touched by rain, they become more fresh and vibrant.
Fēi qíng bùkě shè. If it isn't clear weather, it's impossible to traverse.
Yǒu shù xiān lín shēng. There is a tree that grew before the forest.
Jì nián yú yíbèi. Its age is more than double.
Ask what sort of person he is,
His surname is "Pín" (poverty), his given name is "Yuē Qióng" (called destitution).
If he is wise, then you should accept him.
If he is not wise, then you should not associate with him.
If you are wise, others will accept you.
If you are not wise, they will also reject you.
Praise goodness and take pity on those who are unable.
Benevolent disciples will then find their place.
Persuade (people) to reject the words of Zǐ Zhāng 子張.
Cast aside the words of Bǔ Shāng 卜商.
If customs are shallow, they truly become shallow.
People's hearts are all different.
Old Yīn 殷 laughs at old Liǔ 柳.
Old Liǔ 柳 laughs at old Yīn 殷.
Why do they laugh at each other?
Both are acting within the realm of flattery and bias.
They load their carts, competing to see whose is higher.
They overturn their loads, each soaked with moisture.
When I had money,
I always lent it to you.
Now that you are full and warm,
You do not share with me.
You must remember when you wanted something,
Like I am hoping for now.
Having and not having alternates,
I urge you to think it over carefully.
Zuó diào Xú Wǔ sǐ. Yesterday I mourned the death of Xú Wǔ.
Jīn sòng Liú Sān zàng. Today I escort Liú Sān to his burial.
Zhōng rì bùdé xián. All day long, I cannot find leisure.
Wèi cǐ xīn qīchuàng. Because of this, my heart is grieved.
Yǒu lè qiě xū lè. If there is joy, then one must rejoice.
Shí zāi bùkě shī. Time is not to be lost.
Although they say one hundred years,
How can one fill thirty thousand days?
Living in this world is but a moment.
Do not be stingy when it comes to money.
The final chapter of the Classic of Filial Piety,
Exhaustively expresses its feelings.
Sitting alone, I am often lost in thought.
My feelings, how vast and lingering.
Clouds hang low on the mountainside.
The wind howls at the mouth of the valley.
Monkeys come, the trees sway gently.
Birds enter, the forest chirps.
Time urges, my temples rustle.
The year ends, old age brings regret.
One person with a generous belly,
Is versed in all six arts.
Seen in the south, driven back to the north.
The west wind hastens him to the east.
Drifting long, like floating duckweed.
Restless, like flying tumbleweed.
I wear a single layer for dancing,
and empty my wine cup because I'm drunk from singing.
One should seek to fill clothing and belly,
and not allow one's two legs to become weary.
When weeds grow through your skull,
on that day you will surely regret it.
Wǒ xíng jīng gǔfén. I walk past the ancient graves.
Lèi jìn jiē cún mò. Tears are exhausted as I sigh at those who are gone.
Zhǒng pò yā huángcháng. The tomb is broken, pressing down on the *huángcháng* (cedar-lined tomb).
Guān chuān lù báigǔ. The coffin is pierced, exposing white bones.
Qīxié yǒu wèng píng. Tilted and askew, there are jars and bottles.
Chéngbō wú zānhù. Stirring them, there are no hairpins or tablets.
Fēng zhì lǎn qí zhōng. When the wind comes, it gathers within them.
Huīchén luàn bèi bèi. Dust swirls in disorder.
Xīyáng xià xīshān. The setting sun descends behind the western mountains.
Cǎomù guāng yè yè. The light on the grass and trees is bright.
Fù yǒu ménglóng chù. And there are also dim places.
Sōng luó xiāng liánjiē. Pine and ivy connect with each other.
Cǐ zhōng duō fú hǔ. In this place, there are many hidden tigers.
Jiàn wǒ fèn xùn liè. Seeing me, they bristle their manes.
Shǒuzhōng wú cùn rèn. In my hand, there is not an inch of blade.
Zhēng bù jù shè shè? How can I not be afraid and trembling?
Chūshēng jì rǎorǎo. Birth is full of turmoil.
Shìshì fēi yī zhuàng. The affairs of the world are not of one kind.
Wèi néng shě liúsú. I have not been able to abandon the common customs.
Suǒyǐ xiāng zhuīfǎng. Therefore, we visit each other.
Rén yǐ shēn wéi běn. Man takes the body as the root,
Běn yǐ xīn wéi bǐng. The root takes the heart/mind as the handle.
Běn zài xīn mò xié. If the root resides in a deceitful heart/mind,
Xīn xié sàng běnmìng. The heart/mind's deception will cause the loss of fundamental life.
Wèi néng miǎn cǐ yāng. If you cannot avoid this disaster,
Hé yán lǎn zhào jìng. How can you say you are too lazy to look in the mirror?
You don't recite the Diamond Sutra,
and instead you make the Bodhisattva sick.
There was an old man of the Zhòng family north of the city.
His family had plenty of wine and meat.
When the old man Zhòng's wife died,
the mourners filled the hall.
When old man Zhòng himself died,
there wasn't a single person to cry.
Those who ate his cups and meat,
how very cold-hearted they were!
The foolish read my poems,
and not understanding, they sneer and ridicule.
The mediocre read my poems,
and pondering, they say they are quite important.
The wise read my poems,
and holding them, their faces are full of smiles.
Yáng Xiū saw a young woman,
and with one glance, he knew her excellence.
There naturally are stingy people,
but I am not among the stingy.
Chèngchuí luò dōnghǎi. The weight of the steelyard falls into the Eastern Sea.
Dàodǐ shǐ zhī xiū. Only at the bottom will it know rest.
Shì yǒu yī děng liú. In the world, there is a kind of person,
yōuyōu sì mùtou. carefree, like a wooden block.
Chū yǔ wú zhī jiě. Their words show no understanding.
Yún wǒ bǎi bù yōu. They say they have no worries at all.
Wèn Dào Dào bù huì. Ask them about the Dao, and they don't understand.
Wèn Fó Fó bù qiú. Ask them about the Buddha, and they don't seek him.
Zǐxì tuīxúnzhe. Examining them closely,
Mángrán yī cháng chóu. One finds only a vast and utter sorrow.
Dǒng Láng niánshào shí. When young Master Dǒng was young,
Chūrù Dìjīng lǐ. He went in and out of the imperial capital.
Shān zuò nèn é huáng. His robe was made of tender goose-yellow silk,
Róngyí huà xiāngsì. His appearance like a painting.
Cháng qí tàxuě mǎ. He often rode a horse named "Trampling Snow,"
Fúfú hóngchén qǐ. Raising clouds of red dust.
Guānzhě mǎn lù bàng. Spectators lined the roads,
Gè shì shéi jiā zǐ? Wondering, "Whose son is that?"
Gè shì shéi jiā zǐ? Whose son is that?
Wéi rén dà bèi zēng. As a person, he is greatly hated.
Chīxīn cháng fènfèn. His foolish heart is always resentful.
Ròuyǎn zuì mēngmēng. His physical eyes are drunk and dim.
Jiàn Fó bù lǐ Fó. He sees the Buddha but doesn't pay respect,
Féng Sēng bù shī Sēng. He meets a monk but doesn't give alms.
Wéi zhī dǎ dà luàn. He only knows how to eat large chunks of meat,
Chú cǐ bǎi wú néng. Besides this, he is capable of nothing.
The calves then give birth to their own offspring.
The accumulation is endless.
A message to Táo Zhū Gōng 陶朱公:
Wealth is similar to yours.
Where are you going so distressed?
In choosing a place to live, one must examine it carefully.
Nánfāng zhànglì duō. The southern regions have much miasma and pestilence.
Běidì fēngshuāng shèn. The northern lands have severe winds and frost.
Huāng zōu bùkě jū. Wild corners are uninhabitable.
Dú chuān nánkě yǐn. Poisonous streams are undrinkable.
Hún xī guī qù lái. O Soul, return, come back!
Shí wǒ jiā yuán shèn. Eat the mulberries in my garden.
Zuóyè mèng hái jiā. Last night I dreamed of returning home.
Jiàn fù jī zhōng zhī. I saw my wife weaving at the loom.
Zhù suō rú yǒu sī. The shuttle paused as if lost in thought.
Qíng suō sì wú lì. Holding the shuttle, she seemed without strength.
Hū zhī huí miàn shì. I called to her, and she turned her face to look.
Kuàng fù bù xiāngshí. Moreover, she did not recognize me.
Yīng shì bié duōnián. It must be that we have been separated for many years.
Bìn máo fēi jiù sè. The hair at her temples is no longer the old color.
Rénshēng bù mǎn bǎi. Human life does not reach a hundred years.
Cháng huái qiān zǎi yōu. Yet one constantly harbors worries for a thousand years.
Zìshēn bìng shǐ kě. One's own illness has just begun to heal.
Yòu wèi zǐsūn chóu. And yet, one worries for one's descendants.
Xià shì hé gēn tǔ. Look down at the soil at the roots of the grain.
Shàng kàn sāngshù tóu. Look up at the top of the mulberry tree.
Everyone calls him "Sir."
All praise him as a scholar.
But he has not yet obtained an official position.
And does not understand how to hold a plow.
In winter, he wears a tattered cloth shirt.
Truly, it is books that have misled him.
The birds sing, the feeling unbearable. ？？
At that time, I lie in a thatched hut.
The cherries are red and glistening.
The willows are flourishing.
The rising sun holds the green mountains.
Clear clouds wash the green pool.
Who knows he emerged from the mundane world.
Riding to the south of Hán Shān 寒山.
Yesterday, how carefree.
In the field, pitiful indeed.
Above, it is a path of peach and plum trees.
Below, it becomes an islet of orchids and fragrant herbs.
Moreover, there are elegantly dressed people.
In the house, with jade-green feathers.
Meeting, wanting to call out to each other.
Silently, unable to speak.
A man must not be confined by poverty.
Without money, one must engage in business.
Raising a mother cow.
Producing five calves.
xīn gǔ shàng wèi shú. The new grain is not yet ripe.
jiù gǔ jīn yǐ wú. The old grain is now gone.
jiù dài yī dǒu xǔ. Borrowing about one *dǒu*.
mén wài lì chí chú. Standing hesitantly outside the door.
fū chū jiào wèn fù. The husband comes out and is told to ask the wife.
fù chū qiǎn wèn fū. The wife comes out and is sent to ask the husband.
Miserly hoarding cannot relieve poverty.
Much wealth becomes a burden to the foolish.
There are many laughable things.
Briefly I present three or five.
Zhāng Gōng is rich and extravagant.
Mèngzǐ is poor and down on his luck.
Only taking care of the dwarf until he's full.
Not pitying Dōngfāng Shuò for his hunger.
There are many who sing vulgar songs.
"White Snow" has no one to harmonize with it.
An old man marries a young wife.
With white hair, the wife can't bear it.
An old woman marries a young husband.
With a sallow face, the husband doesn't love her.
An old man marries an old woman.
Neither one is abandoned.
A young woman marries a young husband.
Each pair shows affection for the other.
A refined and handsome young man.
Broadly reads all the classics and histories.
Wèi néng duān sì jiàn. If you cannot be straight as an arrow,
Qiě mò qū rú gōu. Then don't be bent like a hook.
Yún shān dié dié lián tiān bì. Layer upon layer of cloudy mountains connects to the sky's blueness.
Lù pì lín shēn wú kè yóu. The path is secluded, and the forest deep, with no travelers passing through.
Yuǎn wàng gū chán míng jiǎojiǎo. Gazing afar, the lone moon shines brightly.
Jìn wén qún niǎo yǔ jiūjiū. Hearing closely, the flock of birds chirps.
lǎo fū dú zuò qī qīng zhàng. This old man sits alone, dwelling on the green peaks.
shǎo shì xián jū rèn bái tóu. Living leisurely in the Shàoshì Mountains, I let my hair turn white.
kě tàn wǎng nián yǔ jīn rì. Alas, past years and today,
wú xīn hái sì shuǐ dōng liú. My lack of ambition is like water flowing eastward.
fù guì shū qīn jù. The wealthy gather even if relatives are distant,
zhǐ wèi duō qián mǐ. Only for much money and rice.
pín jiàn gǔ ròu lí. The poor and lowly are separated from their flesh and blood,
fēi guān shǎo xiōng dì. Not because they lack brothers.
jí xū guī qù lái. Quickly must one return.
zhāo xián gé wèi qǐ. The Hall for Summoning Worthies is not yet open.
làng xíng zhū què jiē. Aimlessly walking down Vermilion Bird Street,
tà pò pí xié dǐ. I have worn out the soles of my leather shoes.
wǒ jiàn yī chī hàn. I saw a foolish man,
réng jū sān liǎng fù. Still living with two or three wives.
yǎng dé bā jiǔ ér. Raising eight or nine children,
zǒng shì suí yí shǒu. Always taking opportunistic actions.
dīng fáng shì xīn chāi. The labor service duty is newly assigned.
zī cái fēi jiù yǒu. The wealth is not originally his.
huáng bò zuò lǘ qiū. Using cork elm as a donkey's swing (punishment device).
shǐ zhī kǔ zài hòu. Only then did he know the bitterness was yet to come.
Lú shāo jiāng dài xí. (Reeds and rushes will be used as mats.)
Jiāoyè qiě chōng pán. (Banana leaves will be used as plates.)
Zuì hòu zhī yí zuò. (After being drunk, propping the chin while sitting.)
Xūmí xiǎo dánwán. (Mount Sumeru is as small as a pellet.)
Gè shì hé cuò dà? (Who is this scholar?)
Shí lái shěng Nányuàn. (Sometimes coming to visit the Southern Academy.)
Nián kě sānshí yú. His age is perhaps thirty-odd.
